In the evaluation run with run_evaluation.py the agent rated the same email phishing, risk 75, so the result is not stable between runs.

No crash and a warning that the email has no headers, but the verdict was phishing, risk 75, with an explanation that invents a gmail.com sender. Limitation: non-email text is not rejected and the model can hallucinate; a minimal-input guard in the parser would fix this.
